why: A session teardown that never stops its driver. The retired session's frame loop stays registered AND keeps stepping its own disposed world every frame, alongside the live session's -- two simulations advancing on one page after a single Campaign<->Versus switch. NOT new coverage: measured on origin/main, this mutation already failed 1 of 388, at 'stops the frame loop, so a queued callback cannot advance the world'. What issue #317 adds is the repeated-route view of the same defect -- 3 of 397 now, the pre-existing case plus 'leaves exactly one outstanding frame registration' and 'leaves exactly one frame loop still ADVANCING the world'. Failing BOTH of those is what separates this from `retired-session-frame-loop-never-cancelled`, which fails only the first; that contrast is measured, not assumed.
